title: Covered With Fire, Not Water: What the 2026 El Niño Drought Reveals About Central America's Power Grid and the Panama Canal
detail: Water supplied 22 percent of Guatemala's power on 18 September, against 62 percent a year earlier, and the spot price rose 86 percent. A physical-risk screen sees almost nothing at the plants that filled the gap; the carbon bill is the number that matters.
author: Shrinivash D Kannan
